description: This file defines the class VtigerModuleOperation, which manages CRUD operations and metadata descriptions for a specific module in the vtiger CRM web service API. It extends WebserviceEntityOperation and provides functionality such as create, retrieve, update, revise, delete, query, and describe for module entities.

classes.name: VtigerModuleOperation
classes.description: This class manages CRUD operations and metadata for vtiger CRM modules via web services. It extends WebserviceEntityOperation and implements methods for creating, retrieving, updating, revising, deleting, describing, and querying module entities. It also handles module field descriptions and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: VtigerModuleOperation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation with webservice object, user, database connection, and log, and retrieves module metadata.

methods.name: getMetaInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates and caches the module's metadata instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new CRM object from the provided element, handling error checking and bulk save mode.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a CRM object by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing CRM object with provided data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CRM object by its ID.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a query against CRM data with transaction management and permission checks.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Returns metadata and permissions for a module type, including fields.

methods.name: getModuleFields
methods.description: Retrieves and describes the module's fields for metadata.

methods.name: getDescribeFieldArray
methods.description: Generates an array describing a field for metadata, including label, type, and permissions.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns internal metadata object for the module.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the description array for a specific field.
